audit.whatIsWrong: The page called this an EVEN matchup at 5.5/10 while the data shows a 34.92% win rate over 63 games. The full-layer level chart also read 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer read Karma/Karma/Karma/Skill/Brand/Brand/Brand.
audit.why: A 34.92% win rate over 63 games is not an even lane. Brand out-ranges Karma with Sear at 1050 to her 950 Q and his burn-item spike turns one landed ability into a health bar, so the lane is early-Karma and then decisively his.
audit.corrected: diff HARD, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 7.5/10, and the full-layer sides moved onto the content values with every why rewritten to match.
sources: brief.enemyKit Brand Q range 1050 vs Karma Q 950

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose named no cooldowns and the level 6 row claimed the spike favoured Karma.
audit.why: Karma gains only a Mantra rank at 6; Brand gains Pyroclasm on 100/90/80s, which bounces up to 5 times and prioritises stacking Blaze to max on champions. That is the level where the lane changes hands.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the 5-bounce, 100s Pyroclasm; phases[5].why states his burn-item spike.
sources: brief.enemyKit Brand R cd 100/90/80, text 'bounces up to 5 times'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the decisive interaction — that Sear only stuns a target that is already ablaze — was stated but never turned into sequencing. Packet flagged zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and stuns ONLY if Blaze is already on you, so the ability that actually decides the trade is whichever of Pillar of Flame (10s to 8s, 900 range) or Conflagration (13s to 9s, 625 range) lands first. Karma's Focused Resolve is 675 range — a step outside Conflagration — and her Soul Shield is 10s to 8s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull and dontsFull now carry the real numbers and the ablaze-then-stun sequence.
sources: brief.enemyKit Brand Q/W/E cds and ranges
brief.ownerKit Karma W range 675, E cd 10/9.5/9/8.5/8

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions offered 'Brand can cut your retreat with Pillar of Flame (W) and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.'
audit.why: The derived 'terrain' flag on Pillar of Flame contradicts Riot's own description, which creates a damaging zone, not terrain. Per the standing rule I trust the description and did NOT write the retreat-cutting claim.

edits.before: Full kit: W tether roots overstayers and E speeds every trade exit. Your early is the best in the utility class.
edits.after: Focused Resolve roots at 675 — one step outside Conflagration's 625 — and Soul Shield covers the trade back.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — the RQ chunk cycles every 30 seconds. Chip him below half and hold the kill window.
edits.after: Skill window: he has Blaze stacking and a 9s Conflagration, you have RQ. Whoever lands first owns the trade.

edits.before: No new ult — your 6 is a Mantra rank: faster cycles, bigger RQs. Press the early lead before scaling lanes wake up.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces up to 5 times off you and nearby minions — a 100s ult that beats anything your level 6 adds.

edits.before: Blackfire/Luden's spike: RQ-W chains threaten kills outright. The lane is now or never — you fall off politely.
edits.after: His burn item turns one landed ability into a health bar; your shield covers a slice of that and no more.

edits.before: Late Karma is a utility engine: RE shields the team, W roots the diver, and RQ pokes the objective setup.
edits.after: Stacked Blaze plus a bouncing Pyroclasm out-damages what you can shield — you play pure peel from here.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by getting Blaze onto you first so Sear stuns, then bouncing a 100s Pyroclasm through your grouped team.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer.
edits.after: Poke with Q while you carry no Blaze stack — un-ablaze, Sear cannot stun. If he answers with Conflagration, W-root from 675 and walk out.

edits.before: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
edits.after: Trading once you are ablaze — his next Sear stuns you and the full Blaze detonation lands while you cannot move.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer. Bad trade: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
edits.after: Good trade: Poke with Q while you carry no Blaze stack — un-ablaze, Sear cannot stun. If he answers with Conflagration, W-root from 675 and walk out. Bad trade: Trading once you are ablaze — his next Sear stuns you and the full Blaze detonation lands while you cannot move.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Count it out loud if you must. - Your RE shield-speed has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sear is 8s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5, and only stuns a target already ablaze — so the ability to dodge is whichever lands first, Pillar of Flame or Conflagration. - Conflagration is 625 range against your 675 W: root him from a step outside it. - Pyroclasm is 100s; once spent, commit.

edits.before: If Brand takes first blood, tighten up: Sear (Stun) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q and stay relevant through shields and roots.
edits.after: If Brand takes first blood his burn item lands early and one rotation kills you. Farm with Q from 950, stay outside Pillar of Flame's 900, and stay relevant by shielding whoever he opens on.

edits.before: Carry early or enable late — RQ chips win lanes; RE + roots win the teamfights your early lead bought.
edits.after: Carry before he finishes a burn item — after it, you shield the target he opens on and root him off it.

edits.after: Ahead, sprint: deny his CS so Blaze never refunds him mana, take plates, and W-root him whenever Conflagration is on its 13s.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, and on real windows RQ-W: the chunk plus tether-root turns a poke trade into a kill setup — E out before the answer.

edits.before: Brand whiffs Sear (Stun) and the lane briefly belongs to you.

edits.before: That is Brand’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.

edits.before: Your tether breaks if YOU walk away — holding the root means holding your ground for two seconds you must plan for.

edits.before: Spending Mantra on wave-clear while behind on poke — Karma without RQ banked is a support who took mid's farm.
